description: Component keys quarantined from price matching (DB-sync Fase 2). These 14 keys are NOT resources: every one is a formula variable of the hourly equipment-cost calculation that leaked into the components of AHSP item 4.1.1.1 (CIPTA_KARYA) — single-letter codes (A, CP, D, E, F, G, I, J, K, L, M, MP, P, W), count=1 each, coefficient null, units that are prices or formula parameters (rp/jam, tahun, ton, liter, '-'). Quarantine, don't delete: the keys stay in the resource index (flagged) and stay unpriced; they are never matched to a price row. Mechanism note: ahspQuarantine.ts applies to AHSP ITEM codes, not component keys — this pipeline-local list is the correct mechanism for component keys (see phase2-sync.md §4).
